## Skills
### Practice: agents & LLM
- Agentic workflow: spec → plan → task → review → audit, one commit per task; rules, skills and hooks shared by every agent, wired to MCP tools for browser and IDE checks. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode. See https://github.com/netoun/netoun.github.io/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Tool-calling LLM pipelines: subagents call tools and return schema-validated output, turning 100+ page PDFs into structured data; every quoted piece of evidence is checked against the source text (AI SDK, zod, queues, OCR; client work, not listed; Cuevr)
- LLM evaluation: ground-truth datasets, field-level accuracy weighted by criticality, prompt and model comparison, replay of past runs (client work, not listed)
- LLMOps: prompts versioned in git and promoted from development to production, every step traced (Langfuse, OpenTelemetry, Sentry; client work, not listed)

### Stack (each tool ships in a project, a job, a Lab or this site)

- Backend: NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, MikroORM, Bun, Elysia, Cloudflare, Keycloak, Zod, Monorepos, Queues, Streaming
- Creative: Three.js, Canvas 2D, WebGL, WebGPU, Rust, Python
- Tooling: Vite, Vitest
